crs: TWD97 / TM2 zone 121 + TWVD 2001 height - EPSG:3826+8904 [TWGEOID2018h]
ai_summary_zh: 本區道路包含鋪面步道與聯外道路，總面積約532.3平方公尺。河岸周邊調查到35株樹木（平均胸高直徑約29.2公分），水域空洞面積約274.9平方公尺（水位標高TWVD2001 +7.51公尺），並建有總垂直面積達944.6平方公尺之擋土壁與結構牆體。
ai_summary_en: The site features paved access roads and pedestrian paths covering approximately 532.3 m². A riparian stand of 35 trees (mean DBH 29.2 cm) borders the water bodies, which exhibit un-modelled voids totaling 274.9 m² with a shoreline height of TWVD2001 +7.51 m, alongside 944.6 m² of vertical retaining wall structures.
